fns.rule: MSC-logic/EXP05-C (functional bug, no clean CERT match)
fns.desc: aes_decrypt() calls aes_ecb_encrypt() instead of an ECB decrypt primitive (same body as aes_encrypt(), only arg names swapped), so decrypting with this backend actually re-encrypts the ciphertext buffer in place instead of decrypting it -- a real correctness/crypto bug, not just the cast-away-const sqc flagged on the same line for an unrelated (if also valid) reason. Likely long-dormant since CONFIG_INTERNAL_LIBTOMCRYPT is a rare/legacy TLS backend (recent upstream commit 'crypto: Remove some unreachable algorithms' suggests active pruning of this class of code).
